description.en:
Removes several characters, one after the other, with the leaving presentation. For each character, the sound effect sys_021 plays (CMND_SND_OPEN_SYS_SE(21)), the system message "sysmes-remove_party" is shown with the character's name filled in, then the character is removed; the next one waits until the sound has finished.
The BGM is first stopped with a fade of 30, then the function waits 45 frames; once everyone is removed, the BGM plays again with a fade of 30 and the function waits 30 more frames.
It is RemoveParty_MessageEx(_rmv_num, _aParamID, _aStReset, 30, 45, 21, 0, "sysmes-remove_party", _not_pt_lock).
Number of characters to remove (read from index 0 of the arrays).
Parameter IDs of the characters to remove.
true to call RemovePartyCmnd(id, reset, false) instead of RemoveParty(id, reset); see RemoveParty for the difference.

examples.case: Wrapped by an event's local helper that shows a black backdrop (real usage, from ev42014600.nut)
